section.content: 本发明涉及铝离子电池技术领域，具体涉及一种负极/陶瓷隔膜一体化电极及其制备方法和应用。本发明通过原子层沉积法、涂覆法、化学气相沉积法在铝箔表面形成三氧化二铝、二氧化锆、二氧化钛、二氧化硅、钛酸钡无机陶瓷薄膜，将其制备成为负极/陶瓷隔膜一体化电极，应用于铝离子电池中。该负极/陶瓷隔膜一体化电极具有化学稳定性、电化学稳定性、热稳定性好，制造能耗低，安全环保，电池组装简便等优势。通过本发明方法制备的负极/陶瓷隔膜一体化电极拓宽了无机陶瓷材料在电池技术领域的应用。

The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum ion batteries, in particular to a cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode and a preparation method and application thereof. According to the invention, an inorganic ceramic film of aluminum oxide, zirconium dioxide, titanium dioxide, silicon dioxide and barium titanate is formed on the surface of an aluminum foil by an atomic layer deposition method, a coating method and a chemical vapor deposition method, and the inorganic ceramic film is prepared into an integrated electrode of a negative electrode/ceramic diaphragm, and is applied to an aluminum ion battery. The cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode has the advantages of good chemical stability, electrochemical stability and thermal stability, low manufacturing energy consumption, safety, environmental protection, simple and convenient battery assembly and the like. The cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode prepared by the method widens the application of inorganic ceramic materials in the technical field of batteries.

Cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode and preparation method and application thereofTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of aluminum ion batteries, in particular to a cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode and a preparation method and application thereof.

Background

Aluminum is the most abundant metal element in the crust, and has the characteristics of light weight, good ductility, good electric and thermal conductivity, stable chemical properties and the like. The theoretical volume specific capacity and the mass specific capacity of the aluminum metal anode are respectively 8048 mAh.cm -3 And 2981 mAh.g -1 Therefore, rechargeable Aluminum Ion Batteries (AIBs) are a very promising next generation energy storage battery system due to their high mass/volume energy density, low cost, and high safety. Four major components of Aluminum Ion Batteries (AIBs) include: aluminum cathode, diaphragm, electrolyte and cathode. The membrane is positioned between the anode and the cathode in the battery, is a film with a micropore structure, and has the main function of separating the anode from the cathode, preventing the anode from being directly contacted to cause short circuit, and meanwhile, ions can pass through micropores to form a charge-discharge loop so as to ensure the normal operation of the battery; the performance of the diaphragm determines the interface structure and internal resistance of the battery, and directly influences the capacity, circulation and safety performance of the battery.

At present, most of reported battery diaphragms applicable to AIBs are Glass Fiber (GF) diaphragms, and the GF diaphragms have the advantages of small thermal expansion coefficient (tolerance temperature 550 ℃), good structural stability, good chemical stability, high liquid absorption rate, high ion conductivity and the like, and can meet the requirements of battery charging and discharging. However, the preparation process of the Glass Fiber (GF) diaphragm is complex, the energy consumption is high, the cost is high, the surface is smooth, the brittleness is high, the bonding force between the fibers is low, and the physical strength of the Glass Fiber (GF) diaphragm is low; secondly, the traditional Glass Fiber (GF) diaphragm is mutually independent of the anode and the cathode of the battery, the battery assembly is formed by stacking and assembling anode and cathode electrode plates and the diaphragm, and the layered stacking design can easily cause interlayer slippage so as to cause the short circuit or micro short circuit phenomenon of the battery.

Disclosure of Invention

Aiming at the defects existing in the prior art, the invention provides a cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode, a preparation method and application thereof, and the invention aims at simplifyingPreparation process of chemical membrane, reduced cost and energy consumption, improved cycle life of battery, and respectively selecting barium titanate (BaTiO) 3 ) Titanium dioxide (TiO) 2 ) Silicon dioxide (SiO) 2 ) Zirconium dioxide (ZrO) 2 ) Aluminum oxide (Al) 2 O 3 ) Five inorganic ceramic particles are self-assembled on the surface of an anode of an aluminum ion battery, namely an aluminum negative electrode, by adopting an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), a coating method and a Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) method to form a negative electrode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode, so that AIBS (aluminum-zinc alloy) effective long cycle is realized.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the technical scheme of the invention is as follows:

an integrated electrode of negative electrode/ceramic diaphragm comprises a diaphragm substrate (namely aluminum foil) and an inorganic ceramic particle film layer coated on the diaphragm substrate. The cathode/ceramic membrane integrated electrode does not need any other membrane base material, namely, the inorganic ceramic particle layer is directly used as a membrane, and has the liquid storage and liquid retention performances. Secondly, the thickness of the whole inorganic ceramic film layer is kept in the range of 100-200 mu m, because the excessive thickness of the inorganic ceramic film layer can increase the internal resistance of the battery and reduce the energy density of the whole battery; if the thickness is too small, the liquid storage amount is insufficient, and the battery cannot realize long-term circulation; no binder and dispersing agent are needed for the cathode/ceramic separator integrated electrode prepared by using an atomic layer deposition method and a chemical vapor deposition method.

The preparation method of the cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode comprises the following steps:

(1) Cleaning the aluminum foil substrate to obtain a treated aluminum foil;

the process of cleaning the aluminum foil comprises the following steps: sequentially ultrasonically cleaning aluminum foil with purity of over 99.9% in acetone solution, ethanol solution and deionized water for 10-60min, ultrasonically cleaning in the acetone solution for 10-60min in ethanol and deionized water, and then drying to obtain clean aluminum foil, wherein the drying temperature is 60-100 ℃ and the drying time is 30-90min;

(2) Depositing BaTiO on the surface of the treated aluminum foil in the step (1) by adopting an atomic layer deposition method 3 、TiO 2 、SiO 2 、ZrO 2 Or Al 2 O 3 Particles, obtain the cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode;

or: coating BaTiO on the surface of the treated aluminum foil in the step (1) by adopting a coating method 3 、TiO 2 、SiO 2 、ZrO 2 、Al 2 O 3 One or two of the particles, a cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode is obtained;

or: depositing TiO on the surface of the treated aluminum foil in the step (1) by adopting a chemical vapor deposition method 2 Or SiO 2 And (3) particles, so as to obtain the cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode.

Preferably, the step (2) is carried out by preparing the cathode/Al by an atomic layer deposition method 2 O 3 Specific conditions of the separator-integrated electrode: the growth temperature is 100-500 ℃, the precursor is trimethylaluminum, the source temperature of trimethylaluminum is 10-100 ℃, the carrier gas is argon, the introducing time is 0.1-5s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; the reactant is H 2 O or O 3 ，H 2 The introducing time of O is 0.1-2s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; al (Al) 2 O 3 The number of deposition turns is 5000-10000.

Preferably, the step (2) is carried out by preparing the anode/ZrO by an atomic layer deposition method 2 Specific conditions of the separator-integrated electrode: the growth temperature is 100-500 ℃, and the precursor is ethyl methyl amino trimethyl zirconium (Zr (EMA) (Me)) 3 ) The source temperature of the ethyl methyl amino trimethyl zirconium is 10-100 ℃, the carrier gas is argon, the introducing time is 0.1-5s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; the reactant is H 2 O or O 3 ，O 3 The introducing time is 0.1-2s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; zrO (ZrO) 2 The number of deposition turns is 5000-10000.

Preferably, the step (2) is used for preparing the anode/TiO by an atomic layer deposition method 2 Specific conditions of the separator-integrated electrode: the growth temperature is 170-300 ℃; the precursor is titanium tetramethoxide or tetraisopropyl titanate, the source temperature of the tetraisopropyl titanate is 60-85 ℃, the carrier gas is argon, the introducing time is 0.2-5s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; the reactant is H 2 O or O 3 ，H 2 The introducing time of O is 0.2-2s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; tiO (titanium dioxide) 2 Is a deposition ring of (2)The number is 5000-10000.

Preferably, the step (2) is used for preparing the anode/SiO by an atomic layer deposition method 2 Specific conditions of the separator-integrated electrode: the growth temperature is 300-350 ℃, the precursor is silicon chloride, bis (diethylamino) silane or silicon hydride, the source temperature is 60-85 ℃, the carrier gas is argon, the introducing time is 0.2-5s, and the diffusion time is 1-10s; the reactant is H 2 O，H 2 The introducing time of O is 0.2-2s, and the diffusion time is 0.1-10s; siO (SiO) 2 The number of deposition turns is 5000-10000.

Preferably, the step (2) is an atomic layer deposition method for preparing the anode/BaTiO 3 Specific conditions of the separator-integrated electrode: the growth temperature is 225-250 ℃, the precursors are tetraisopropyl titanate and bis (triisopropyl chloropentadienyl) barium, the source temperature of the tetraisopropyl titanate is 35-41 ℃, the source temperature of the bis (triisopropyl chloropentadienyl) barium is 145-151 ℃, the carrier gas is argon, the introducing time of the tetraisopropyl titanate and the bis (triisopropyl chloropentadienyl) barium is 2-5s, and the diffusion time is 15-20s; the reactant is H 2 O，H 2 The introducing time of O is 1-2s, and the diffusion time is 15-20s; the number of cycles per unit of tetraisopropyl titanate and barium bis (triisopropylchloropentadienyl) is 4:3 to ensure formation of BaTiO 3 The ratio of Ba to Ti in (c) is close to 50:50, the number of deposition turns of tetraisopropyl titanate and bis (triisopropyl chloropentadienyl) barium is 5000-10000.

Preferably, the specific operation of preparing the cathode/ceramic separator integrated electrode by the coating method in the step (2) is as follows: weighing the following raw materials in parts by weight: 60 parts of ceramic particles, 0.6-1.2 parts of binder, 6-12 parts of defoamer and 26.8-27.4 parts of dispersing agent, preparing 40mg/mL of binder solution from the binder, uniformly mixing the raw materials to obtain coating slurry, scraping the slurry on the surface of the treated aluminum foil, air-drying at room temperature, and drying to constant weight;

Wherein the ceramic particles are selected from BaTiO 3 、TiO 2 、SiO 2 、ZrO 2 、Al 2 O 3 One or both of the particles.

Preferably, the anode/TiO is prepared by the chemical vapor deposition method in the step (2) 2 Specific conditions of the ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode: the reaction gas comprises a titanium source, a titanium source carrier gas, a shielding gas and an oxygen source, wherein the titanium source is isopropyl titanate, the titanium source carrier gas and the shielding gas are argon, the oxygen source is oxygen, the deposition temperature is 300-500 ℃, and the aluminum foil substrate is heated to 300 ℃ in a reaction chamber before deposition;

wherein the flow rate of the titanium source is 2-10g/min, the flow rate of the oxygen source is 2000-10000sccm, the flow rate of the argon is 3000-6000sccm, the deposition time is 120-360min, and the pressure of the reaction chamber is 6-8 tor.

Preferably, the chemical vapor deposition method in the step (2) prepares the anode/SiO 2 Specific conditions of the ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode: the reaction gas comprises a silicon source, a silicon source carrier gas, a shielding gas and an oxygen source, wherein the silicon source is monosilane or tetraethoxysilane, the silicon source carrier gas and the shielding gas are nitrogen, the oxygen source is oxygen, the deposition temperature is 450-470 ℃, and the aluminum foil substrate is placed in a reaction chamber to be heated to 450 ℃ before deposition;

wherein, the flow rate of the silicon source is 2-10g/min, the flow rate of the oxygen source is 2000-10000sccm, the flow rate of the nitrogen is 3000-6000sccm, the deposition time is 120-360min, and the pressure of the reaction chamber is 6-8 tor.

The invention also protects the cathode/ceramic membrane integrated electrode prepared by the preparation method, and the cathode/ceramic membrane integrated electrode is as follows: forming an inorganic ceramic film on the surface of the aluminum foil, wherein the inorganic ceramic is selected from Al 2 O 3 、ZrO 2 、TiO 2 、SiO 2 、BaTiO 3 The thickness of the inorganic ceramic film is 100-200 mu m, and the thickness of the aluminum foil is 30-125 mu m.

The invention also protects the application of the cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode in preparing the aluminum ion battery, and the application method comprises the following steps:

preparing a positive electrode plate: calcining the expandable graphite raw material at 1000 ℃ for 30 seconds to obtain expanded graphite, and then pressing the expanded graphite to obtain a positive electrode plate;

assembling an aluminum ion battery: and assembling the gasket, the cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode, the anode plate and the current collector in sequence, and then standing to obtain the aluminum ion battery.

Compared with the prior art, the invention has the beneficial effects that:

1. the invention selects inorganic ceramic particles as the separator material of AIBs by three methods, including: an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), a coating method and a Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) method, so that inorganic ceramic particles are self-assembled on the surface of an anode of an AIBS (AIBS), namely an aluminum anode, to form an anode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode, the preparation process of the electrode is simple, the battery is more convenient to assemble by using the electrode, and the short circuit of the battery caused by diaphragm deflection is avoided; secondly, the electrode prepared by the invention ensures that the contact between the negative electrode and the diaphragm is more compact, ensures good contact between the active substance and the electrolyte, and greatly shortens the transmission distance of active ions; finally, the accumulation of inorganic ceramic particles can effectively prevent dendrites from penetrating through the diaphragm to cause short circuit of the battery, and is beneficial to realizing long circulation of the battery. The cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode has the advantages of good chemical stability, electrochemical stability and thermal stability (the thermal stability is improved by compounding ceramic materials), low manufacturing energy consumption, safety, environmental protection, simple and convenient battery assembly and the like. The cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode prepared by the method widens the application of inorganic ceramic materials in the technical field of batteries.

2. The present invention has advantages over conventional Aluminum Ion Battery (AIBs) separators in that:

(1) Security aspect: the cathode/ceramic diaphragm integrated electrode has higher thermal stability, lyophilic property and chemical inertia, can effectively prevent aluminum dendrites from penetrating through the diaphragm in the AIBS charging and discharging process, and avoids short circuit or micro short circuit of the battery, thereby ensuring the safe operation of the AIBS;

(2) The assembly process aspect is as follows: the assembly is simpler and more convenient, and the problem of battery short circuit caused by diaphragm deflection is avoided;

(3) Energy density aspect: thinner and smaller, which is helpful to improve the volume energy density of the rechargeable aluminum battery;

(4) The aspect of the rapid charge and discharge performance: the contact between the Al negative electrode and the diaphragm is tighter, so that the good contact between the active substance and the electrolyte is ensured, and the transmission distance of active ions is greatly shortened;

(5) Cyclic stability aspect: the dense accumulation of inorganic ceramics can effectively prevent dendrites from penetrating through the diaphragm to cause short circuit of the battery, and is beneficial to ensuring long cycle life.
